description: AI Rules Engine - Layer 1 (Foundational) and Layer 3 (Combat) - Ultra-detailed validation system

1.1_MATCH_STRUCTURE.description: Rules governing overall match flow and victory conditions

1.1.1_best_of_5_format.description: Match ends when one player wins 3 rounds

1.1.1.1_match_victory_condition.description: Player wins match when they reach 3 round victories

1.1.1.2_early_victory.description: Match can end before round 5 if player reaches 3 wins
examples: Player wins 3-0: Match ends after round 3
Player wins 3-1: Match ends after round 4

1.1.1.3_impossible_comeback.description: Match cannot continue if opponent cannot mathematically reach 3 wins
1.1.1.3_impossible_comeback.example: If score is 3-0 after round 3, match ends (opponent cannot reach 3)

edge_cases.description: Both cards reach 0 HP same turn
edge_cases.resolution: Draw declared, round replayed with same cards

1.1.2_round_victory_conditions.description: Conditions under which a single round is won

victory_conditions.description: Turn timer expires, higher HP wins
victory_conditions.tiebreaker: If HP equal, round is draw and replayed

victory_conditions.description: Engine-specific instant win (Checkmate, Prophet of Certainty)

1.1.2.1_HP_calculation_timing.description: HP is checked after all simultaneous effects resolve

1.1.3_timeout_and_stalemate.description: Rules for turn timeouts and stalemate situations

stalemate_detection.trigger: No HP change for 10 consecutive turns
stalemate_detection.resolution: Sudden death mode: Both players take 10 damage per turn until winner emerges

1.1.3.1_auto_pass_behavior.description: On timeout, player automatically passes turn (no glyph activated)
1.1.3.1_auto_pass_behavior.effect: Turn passes to opponent, resources regenerate normally

1.2_CARD_SYSTEM.description: Rules governing card creation, stats, and properties

1.2.1_card_creation_rules.description: Rules for creating custom cards in Workshop

restrictions: Must own/unlock glyph to use it
Can use same glyph multiple times (duplicates allowed)
Can mix glyphs from different engines freely

1.2.1.1_duplicate_glyphs.description: Same glyph can be placed multiple times
1.2.1.1_duplicate_glyphs.example: 12x Minor Heal is valid (suboptimal but legal)

1.2.1.2_glyph_unlock_requirement.description: Can only use glyphs that are unlocked in progression
1.2.1.2_glyph_unlock_requirement.enforcement: UI prevents selection of locked glyphs

1.2.2_card_HP_calculation.description: Formula for calculating card's starting HP based on glyphs

1.2.2.1_jyotish_HP_modifiers.description: Jyotish chart can modify final HP
1.2.2.1_jyotish_HP_modifiers.application_order: Calculate base HP → Apply Jyotish modifiers → Enforce min/max constraints

1.2.3_card_stats_calculation.description: How Attack, Defense, Speed stats are derived from glyphs
1.2.3_card_stats_calculation.note: Stats are display values for player reference; actual damage/reduction calculated per glyph

1.2.4_card_naming_and_identity.description: Rules for naming and identifying custom cards

visual_identity.card_art: Auto-generated based on dominant engine and glyph themes
visual_identity.color_scheme: Primary engine determines base color (Tantra=red, Consciousness=blue, etc.)
visual_identity.icon: Dominant glyph keyword determines card icon

unique_identifier.persistence: Unique ID never changes even if card edited

1.3_TURN_STRUCTURE.description: Rules governing individual turn flow within a round

1.3.1_turn_phases.description: Sequential phases that comprise a single turn

phases.name: START_OF_TURN
phases.description: Resource regeneration and start-of-turn effects trigger
actions: Regenerate base resources (KP +1, Prana +5, Sanctity +5, etc.)
Trigger start-of-turn effects ([Burn] tick, [Regen] tick, etc.)
Update cooldowns (reduce all active cooldowns by 1)
Check persistent state expirations (Neural States, [Bless] duration, etc.)

phases.name: PLANNING
phases.description: Player selects glyph to activate (thinking phase)
actions: Player reviews available glyphs (not on cooldown, can afford cost)
phases.validation: Selected glyph must pass cost check and targeting check

phases.name: ACTION
actions: Apply glyph effects (damage, healing, buffs, debuffs)
Update game state (HP, resources, status effects)
phases.order: Cost payment → Primary effect → Triggered effects → State update

phases.name: RESOLUTION
phases.description: After-action effects resolve and state stabilizes
actions: Trigger end-of-turn effects (resource generation, conditional effects)
Prepare for opponent's turn or round end
phases.order: Defeat check → End-of-turn effects → State validation

phases.name: CLEANUP
phases.description: Turn officially ends, transition to next turn

1.3.1.1_phase_interruption.description: Only PLANNING phase can be interrupted (timeout)
1.3.1.1_phase_interruption.validation: Timeout only during phase 2, other phases atomic

1.3.1.2_simultaneous_resolution.description: If multiple effects trigger same phase, resolve by Speed stat
1.3.1.2_simultaneous_resolution.order: Highest Speed resolves first, ties resolved randomly
1.3.1.2_simultaneous_resolution.example: Both players' [Burn] ticks simultaneously → Resolve higher Speed card first

1.3.2_action_economy.description: How many actions a player can take per turn

baseline.description: Player activates 1 glyph per turn (baseline rule)

exceptions.note: Still only 1 glyph selection, but resolves twice

exceptions.effect: Can activate as interrupt during opponent's turn
exceptions.note: Doesn't consume your main action, separate system

1.3.3_turn_order_determination.description: How turn order is decided (sequential vs simultaneous)

order_priority.description: If Speed equal, alternate who goes first each turn
If all else equal, random determination

1.3.3_turn_order_determination.note: Turn order recalculated if Speed stat changes mid-round (rare)

3.1_DAMAGE_SYSTEM.description: Rules governing damage calculation, types, and application

3.1.1_damage_calculation_formula.description: Base formula for calculating damage dealt

components.base_damage: Value specified in glyph description (e.g., Smite deals 40 base)
components.type_modifier: Damage type advantages (usually 1.0, no types advantage system currently)

3.1.1_damage_calculation_formula.rounding: Always round down (floor) to nearest integer
3.1.1_damage_calculation_formula.note: Minimum 1 damage always dealt unless explicitly negated by [Counter] or immunity

3.1.2_damage_types.description: Different damage types and their properties

types.examples: Smite, Wrath of Heaven, Divine Punishment

types.special: Applied as status, ticks each turn

types.examples: Certain Singularity [Collapse] effects, specific ultimate abilities

3.1.2_damage_types.note: Currently no elemental weakness/resistance system (future expansion possible)

3.1.3_damage_reduction_and_amplification.description: How damage is modified by buffs/debuffs

reduction_sources.example: 50 damage vs 30 shield = 20 damage to HP, shield broken

reduction_sources.note: Complete immunity, but cannot act offensively

3.1.3_damage_reduction_and_amplification.stacking_order: Base damage → Defense reduction → Shield absorption → Status amplifications → Final damage to HP

3.1.4_overkill_rules.description: What happens when damage exceeds target HP
3.1.4_overkill_rules.behavior: Excess damage is ignored (does not carry over)
3.1.4_overkill_rules.example: Target has 10 HP, attack deals 50 damage → Target reduced to 0 HP, 40 excess damage lost
3.1.4_overkill_rules.exception: Certain glyphs have overkill bonuses (e.g., 'Deal damage equal to overkill to another target')

3.1.5_lethal_damage_and_defeat.description: Card defeat occurs when HP reaches 0
3.1.5_lethal_damage_and_defeat.timing: Checked after RESOLUTION phase (all simultaneous effects resolved)
defeat_effects: Loser must switch to different card next round (if available)
All persistent effects on defeated card are cleared

3.1.5.1_simultaneous_defeat.description: Both cards reach 0 HP same turn
3.1.5.1_simultaneous_defeat.resolution: Round declared draw, rematch with same cards
3.1.5.1_simultaneous_defeat.note: Rare edge case, both [Burn] ticks kill simultaneously

3.1.5.2_resurrection_mechanics.description: Certain glyphs can resurrect defeated cards
3.1.5.2_resurrection_mechanics.timing: Can only resurrect between rounds, not mid-round
3.1.5.2_resurrection_mechanics.limitation: Only works in multi-round format (Best of 5)

3.2_HEALING_SYSTEM.description: Rules governing healing calculation and restoration

components.base_healing: Value in glyph description (e.g., Minor Heal restores 20)
healing_power_modifiers: Moon planetary influence (+50% if Moon Tier 2+)

3.2.2_overheal_rules.baseline: No overheal (healing capped at max HP)
3.2.2_overheal_rules.example: Card at 90/100 HP receives 20 healing → Restored to 100/100, 10 healing wasted

exceptions.behavior: Temporary HP degrades first, then normal HP
exceptions.duration: Until depleted or end of round

3.2.3_heal_over_time_mechanics.application: HoT effects trigger at START_OF_TURN phase
3.2.3_heal_over_time_mechanics.duration_tracking: Each HoT effect has independent duration counter

3.2.3.1_HoT_interaction_with_heal_block.duration: Heal block applies to all healing including HoT

3.2.4_heal_blocking_effects.behavior: All healing = 0 while heal block active
3.2.4_heal_blocking_effects.visual_indicator: Red cross icon over health bar
3.2.4_heal_blocking_effects.removal: [Cleanse] effects can remove heal block early

3.3_STATUS_EFFECTS.description: Rules for buffs, debuffs, and status effect management

3.3.1_buff_duration_rules.description: How long positive status effects last

duration_types.example: [Blessed] lasts 3 turns → Turn 1, 2, 3 active, expires before Turn 4

duration_types.tracking: Effect remains until specific condition met

3.3.1.1_duration_extension.description: Some effects can extend buff durations
examples: Jupiter planetary influence (+2 turns to [Bless] duration)

3.3.1.2_duration_refresh.behavior: Duration resets to full, potency does NOT stack (unless specified)
3.3.1.2_duration_refresh.example: [Blessed] with 1 turn left → Reapply [Blessed] → Duration resets to 3 turns

3.3.2_debuff_duration_rules.description: How long negative status effects last

debuff_specific_rules.rule: Debuffs can be removed early via [Cleanse]
debuff_specific_rules.priority: Player choice which debuff to cleanse if multiple present

examples: Theta State (Consciousness) - immune to all debuffs

3.3.3_stacking_rules.description: Can same effect apply multiple times?

examples: [Burn] - each application adds +3 damage/turn (max 5 stacks = 15 damage/turn)
stacking_types.cap: Most effects have max stack limit (typically 5-10)

stacking_types.behavior: Duration resets, potency MAY stack depending on effect

stacking_types.description: Effect does not stack, reapplication refreshes only
examples: Heal block - reapplication extends duration but not intensity

3.3.3.1_different_sources_same_effect.behavior: Depends on effect type (see stacking_types above)
3.3.3.1_different_sources_same_effect.example: [Burn] from Tantra + [Burn] from Invocation = Both stacks accumulate

3.3.4_status_priority_and_resolution_ord.description: Order in which multiple status effects resolve
resolution_order: State transition checks (Neural State expiration, etc.)
3.3.4_status_priority_and_resolution_ord.simultaneity_resolution: If multiple effects trigger simultaneously, resolve by Speed stat (higher first)

3.3.4.1_conflicting_effects.example: Heal block (cannot heal) beats HoT effect (can heal) → No healing occurs
3.3.4.1_conflicting_effects.validation: Check negative effects first, then apply positive effects if allowed

behavior.target_priority: Player chooses which effect to remove if multiple present

limitations: Certain effects immune to cleanse (marked as [Permanent] or [Sealed])
Upgraded cleanse glyphs can remove multiple effects

3.3.5.1_mass_cleanse.behavior: Removes ALL debuffs from target simultaneously
3.3.5.1_mass_cleanse.example: Therapeutic ultimate 'Purify' removes all negative status effects

VALIDATION_FRAMEWORK.description: How AI validates game actions against these rules

validation_process.action: Player attempts action (glyph activation, card switch, etc.)
validation_process.validation: Check if action has corresponding rule in this system

validation_process.action: AI looks up rule by rule_id or category
AI checks all sub_rules and edge_cases
validation_process.validation: Ensure no conflicts or special conditions violated

error_message_translation.technical: Validation failed: R-1.2.1.2 - Glyph not in player.unlocked_glyphs
error_message_translation.player_friendly: This glyph is still locked! Unlock it through progression to use it.
